article.title: Google將Gemini Tasks免費開放至六個市場
article.summary: Google公布，可在背景執行多步驟工作的Gemini Tasks，開始在六個市場免費推出。
highlights: 首批包括美國、印度、加拿大、澳洲、日本和南韓。
Google Pay結帳另在美國向合資格成人個人帳戶逐步推出英文版，須由用戶確認。
article.why: 電商團隊可檢查商品價格和庫存能否在搜尋、商品頁及結帳保持一致。
article.next_step: 選一批常缺貨商品，核對補貨狀態和價格上限在結帳前的顧客提示。
article.detail: Google表示，Gemini Tasks可執行多步驟或定期任務，並在結果就緒後通知使用者。另行推出的Google Pay結帳功能可在找到符合預算的商品後準備結帳，向用戶顯示明細並等待確認。六個市場的免費推出名單沒有香港，結帳功能的資格及語言範圍則按美國推出條款處理。
article.title_en: Google begins free rollout of Gemini Tasks in six markets
article.summary_en: Google says Gemini Tasks, which can handle multi-step work in the background, has begun rolling out for free in six markets.
highlights_en: The initial markets are the US, India, Canada, Australia, Japan and South Korea.
Google Pay checkout is rolling out separately in English to eligible US adults with personal accounts and requires user approval.
article.why_en: Commerce teams can check whether prices and inventory agree across search, product pages and checkout.
article.next_step_en: Pick frequently out-of-stock products and review how shoppers see restock status and price limits before checkout.
article.detail_en: Google says Gemini Tasks can take on multi-step or recurring work and tell users when results are ready. The separate Google Pay feature can stage checkout when it finds an item within budget, show an itemized summary and wait for approval. Hong Kong is outside the listed free rollout. The checkout rollout has its own US, language and eligibility limits.
